decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer and has stayed listed through 2024, so it shows no clear shortfall against aspirations and a large firm has the slack to carry it while results mature.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's filtration competence and sustainability goals and has stayed on the market, so no problemistic search is triggered.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of metalworking customers and sit close to the established business, so they likely perform near aspiration and remain in the portfolio.

Hinged belt chip conveyors are a core, widely demanded conveyor type that complements the remaining line after the magnetic belt variant was pruned, so keeping it is consistent with performance at aspiration.
